description: reject: shared borrow of a FIELD projected from a ternary rvalue at a declared-& formal -> E_PROJECTED_RVALUE_ARG_BINDING_REQUIRED (bind-first). The ternary drop-registers its own result, so the borrow-base lift cannot materialize it a second time; upstream rejection keeps it memory-safe.
